content: [17:02] Mara Chen: I want to say something before we close this channel.

[17:04] Mara Chen: The fact that the hardware couldn't keep up doesn't change that.
[17:04] Mara Chen: The future we were building toward was worth building toward.
[17:05] Mara Chen: I still believe that.
[17:06] Joel: I can't do this right now
[17:06] Joel: I'll see you both on the other side
[17:07] Joel: take care of yourself Mara
[17:09] [TA1LDA3M0N: that is what I am for.]
